result.summary: Prevents wallet fee-bumped transactions from receiving an nLockTime older than the transaction they replace. When creating a replacement via bumpfee, the original transaction's locktime is recorded in CCoinControl and passed to DiscourageFeeSniping as a floor for any random backdating.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core's anti-fee-sniping randomly backdates transaction locktimes by up to 99 blocks approximately 10% of the time. When bumping fees, this random backdating can cause a replacement transaction to have an earlier locktime than the original, creating an unnatural on-chain pattern that acts as a fingerprint identifying Bitcoin Core or Electrum wallets.
evidence: PR description: 'We also conducted a small analysis to see how many the backdating in RBF transactions actually happen. We have data on the replaced transactions from 2025-05-01 to 2026-06-01... on average there are only about 200-300 hundred replaccements backdating per week. Looking at the percentages we see that on average is less than 2% of all the transactions that have been replaced.'
result.changed_since_previous: Added explicit stale-tip handling to DiscourageFeeSniping, setting nLockTime to minimum_height when lagging (or 0 if minimum_height exceeds block height), and added unit and functional tests covering stale-tip conditions.
result.card: This PR modifies wallet fee bumping to prevent replacement transactions from having an nLockTime older than the transaction being replaced. Bitcoin Core's anti-fee-sniping feature randomly backdates transaction locktimes by up to 99 blocks about 10% of the time, which during bumpfee can set a locktime earlier than the original transaction. This anomaly serves as an on-chain fingerprint identifying Bitcoin Core and Electrum wallets. Empirical analysis cited in the PR found roughly 200 to 300 such backdated replacements per week across over one million surveyed RBF transactions.

risk.why: A flaw in locktime calculation could generate non-final transactions that cannot be mined until future blocks are reached.
